title: Beautiful Nashville Area Hillside Home
description:
Country aesthetic, nestled in the hillside of Historic Franklin, and just minutes from downtown Nashville. Spacious deck with beautiful hillside view. You will likely see colorful wild birds on my feeders, wild turkeys, chipmunks, deer, etc. Extras include Fire Pit, Corn Hole and Basketball Goal

The space
There are 4 bedrooms. The Master has a King sized bed with its own bathroom. The other 3 bedrooms, 2 Queens and 1 Full size bed, share the other 1 1/2 bathrooms. There is a large TV in the Living Room and a TV in every bedroom.

Guest access
Large driveway with plenty of parking. Spacious deck with patio table and propane heater. Fire pit in the back yard.

Other things to note
I live and work in the basement but no need to worry, it is locked off and completely separate from house with it's own private access. You will have the whole house to yourself and you won't likely see me unless you need something :)
